title: Exports embed an sRGB ICC profile (JPEG, PNG, TIFF), so colour-managed apps and print services read them correctly
notes: Pixels unchanged; only the profile tag is added. The TIFF part goes upstream after #1752.
highlight: **Colour-managed exports.** JPEG, PNG and TIFF files carry an sRGB profile, so browsers, other apps and print labs show your colours as intended.
